thin_screen.method: Actual STL XY sections with canonical edge interpolation and closed-loop assertions at 1.0mm pitch, z offset .071mm; morphological opening radius 0.4mm. Narrow tips and sharp corners also contribute.
thin_screen.judgment: Review fine roof/rim/corner regions and use supports where needed; no automatic printability claim.

support_warning: 前廊長跨、端部樓梯與門廊需要檢查支撐；欄杆已加粗至1.2毫米，但仍需小心處理與試印。
